gloss: the entire sky; the whole sky; across the sky

definitions.gloss: the entire sky; the whole sky; all across the sky
definitions.explanation: Describes the sky in its entirety, typically when it is completely covered or filled by something — clouds, stars, a sunset glow, etc.

examples.japanese: {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がった→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Clouds spread across the entire sky.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夕焼|ゆうや}け→夕焼け：05045_yuuyake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{空一面|そらいちめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{染|そ}めた→染める：04253_someru⟧。
examples.english: The sunset dyed the entire sky red.

examples.japanese: {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{星|ほし}→星：01510_hoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{輝|かがや}いていて→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧、⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ほど⟦{美|うつく}しかった→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: Stars were shining across the entire sky, so beautiful it took my breath away.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧ (sky) and ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧ (the whole surface, all over). Paints a picture of the sky as a single vast expanse uniformly covered or filled by something. Common in literary and descriptive writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧: to spread across the whole sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}う→覆う：02020_oou⟧: to cover the entire sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雲|くも}→雲：02202_kumo⟧: clouds across the whole sky
- {空一面|そらいちめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{灰色|はいいろ}→灰色：04303_haiiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: the entire sky turns gray

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧: snow covering everything — ⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧ can be combined with other surfaces too
- ⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧: as far as the eye can see across the sky

USAGE:
The pattern ～⟦{一面|いちめん}→一面：11184_ichimen⟧ is productive and can be applied to other surfaces: {海一面|うみいちめん} (the entire sea), {野原一面|のはらいちめん} (across the whole field). It always conveys the image of something stretching uniformly over the entire area.
